Jin: Quick thought: instead of immediate rollback on a probe fail, what if we introduce a short 'quarantine' routing with quorum checks to avoid noisy-neighbor false positives?
Priya: Sounds promising. How would quorum look here?
Jin: Each shard serving the variant returns a tiny verdict (OK/DEG/FAIL). Coordinator aggregates over a short window; fallback happens only if quorum of shards vote FAIL.
Marta: For single-shard tenants quorum is 1, so behaviour stays the same. But we should have a softer state where traffic is split (5% variant) while we gather more signals.
Theo: Add multi-signal fusion: verdicts + p95 breaches + error spikes. Use weighted score to decide quarantine -> fallback.
Priya: We must avoid long waits. Verdicts should timeout quickly (300ms) and coordinator must make best-effort decision.
Jin: Also add cooldown after fallback to prevent flip-flops. Default cooldown 10m, exponential backoff on reintroduce.
Marta: Ops: on quarantine enter, increase probe cadence and surface top signals in Console. Page if >3 quarantines in 10m.
Theo: For cross-region conflicts, use a monotonic epoch (HLC) so higher epoch wins.
infra-bot: Feature-flag rollout for "quorum-quarantine" started at 2026-03-23T11:00:00Z for 0.5% tenants.
Priya: Next steps: Jin to draft quick RFC with state machine and verdict proto. I'll work telemetry fields.
Marta: I'll update runbook thresholds and quarantine playbook.
